summary: Backend + frontend testing for iteration 10 (booking window 2 weeks, IST past-slot filter, party-size duration, 7 named tables, dietary/special-service approval toggles, menu CSV upload, events CRUD, /menu + /events pages, homepage Menu highlight & Upcoming events, footer WhatsApp+QR). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10_features.py (19 tests, 18 passed / 1 skipped for 7+ party depending on slot capacity). Ran regression suite backend_test.py — 2 stale assertions (>=8 tables) fixed to >=7 (new seed is 7 named tables), then 42 passed / 1 skipped. Menu default 6 items was restored (upload test restores in teardown). Frontend browser test verified: /menu categorized menu, /events cards, nav Menu+Events links, homepage Menu highlight (home-menu-link), Upcoming events section, footer footer-start-booking + whatsapp-link (wa.me/919000012345) + whatsapp-qr img, BookingPage fee-info, cancellation-policy, dietary-yes/no toggle + dietary-note reveal, special-service-toggle appears only after occasion selected, 15-day date strip. HOWEVER: 'Our tables' section (labeled 'The room / Indoor calm, garden air.') is STILL present on the homepage with hardcoded OLD table names (Sakura, Bamboo, Zen Hall, Garden, Terrace) and '8 tables' text — this contradicts the iteration requirement and the current DB seed of 7 named tables (Spicy/Umami/Salty/Tangy/Fruity/Malty/Smoky).

minor.issue: Window is start=today, end=today+15 (inclusive of 15 days: today..today+14 since bookable is start<=d<end). Review request text says '14 days bookable' — off-by-one vs. the phrase, but matches the explicit 'end=today+15 days' spec. Not a bug, just a doc/spec ambiguity to confirm.
Guarded by count!=0; if items are individually deleted the seed will not self-heal. Consider upsert-by-name. Same finding as iteration 9.

ui_bugs.component: Landing.js — 'The room / Indoor calm, garden air.' section (lines ~160-183)
ui_bugs.issue: Old standalone 'Our tables' section was NOT removed as required by this iteration. It still renders a hardcoded TableMap with names Sakura / Bamboo / Zen Hall / Garden / Terrace and copy referencing '8 tables' — none of which exist in the current DB (seed is 7 named tables Spicy/Umami/Salty/Tangy/Fruity/Malty/Smoky). Users see stale content that does not match reality.

action_items: Remove the 'The room / Indoor calm, garden air.' section from Landing.js (lines ~160-183) OR replace it with a section that reads the real tables from GET /api/tables/public (Spicy/Umami/Salty/Tangy/Fruity/Malty/Smoky, 7 tables) — currently it contradicts both the iteration spec and reality.
Optional: clarify booking-window spec — is bookable range 14 days (today..today+13) or 15 days (today..today+14)? Backend currently allows the latter.
Optional: convert _seed_menu / _seed_events / _seed_tables to upsert-by-name so accidental deletions self-heal on restart.
critical_code_review_comments: Duration semantics are cleanly party-based (party_duration) and reservations store duration_minutes explicitly — good; _table_is_free correctly uses each reservation's own duration for overlap checks.
Allocation cascade verified: 2-guest bookings fall back from 2-seaters to larger tables when 2-seaters are full (test_allocation_cascades_to_larger_tables).

needs_approval logic is correct: >group_threshold (strict >), or (special_needs_approval AND occasion != 'None'), or has_dietary, or (occasion != 'None' AND special_service). Note this means ANY special_occasion (even without special_service) triggers approval as long as special_needs_approval=True (default). Confirm this is intended — the review description implies only 'special_occasion + special_service=true' should require approval, but the code also flips it on for any occasion when special_needs_approval is on.
Landing.js still hardcodes old table showcase — should either be removed or read from /api/tables/public.
server.py is ~1080 lines — continues to grow; splitting into modules (auth/reservations/menu/events/admin) is increasingly warranted.
